//: Pins the .NET SDK so local builds and the GitHub Actions release runner use the exact same toolchain. The SDK major affects the publish output layout (SDK 8 inserts a bin\x64\... platform segment that publish.ps1 does not look in; SDK 10 does not), so a mismatch silently breaks the installer build. rollForward latestMinor lets patch/feature bumps within 10.x flow through; bump 'version' when you move to a new SDK.
